title: CSV 编码、BOM 与分隔符：读进来不对怎么修
expected_output:
=== 1. 中文 CSV 是 GBK 编码 ===
  utf-8 读取失败 -> UnicodeDecodeError : 'utf-8' codec can't decode byte 0xd0 in position 0: invalid 
  改用 encoding='gb18030' 后：
姓名  分数
张三  90
李四  85

=== 2. Excel 存出的 UTF-8 CSV 带 BOM ===
  直接读的列名 = ["'id'", "'name'"]  <- 第一个列名多了 \ufeff
  用 encoding='utf-8-sig' 后列名 = ['id', 'name']

=== 3. 分隔符不是逗号 ===
  默认逗号读 -> shape = (1, 1)  列名 = ['a;b;c']  <- 全挤成一列
  sep=';' 读  -> shape = (1, 3)  列名 = ['a', 'b', 'c']

=== 4. 脏值让数值列退化为 object ===
  默认读：id dtype = int64  amount dtype = str  <- amount 变成 object
  显式指定：id dtype = str  amount dtype = float64
  修正后 id 保留了前导零: ['001', '002', '003']
  修正后 amount 的缺失: [False, True, False]

=== 5. 写出的文件头 ===
  前 3 字节 = efbbbf （efbbbf 即 BOM，Excel 才能正确识别中文）
  index=False 时首行 = id,amount
code:
import pandas as pd
import pathlib, tempfile

d = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())

# ---------- 1) GBK 编码的中文 CSV ----------
gbk = d / "gbk.csv"
gbk.write_bytes("姓名,分数\n张三,90\n李四,85\n".encode("gbk"))
print("=== 1. 中文 CSV 是 GBK 编码 ===")
try:
    pd.read_csv(gbk)
    print("  utf-8 读取：成功（不该发生）")
except UnicodeDecodeError as e:
    print("  utf-8 读取失败 ->", type(e).__name__, ":", str(e)[:60])
print("  改用 encoding='gb18030' 后：")
print(pd.read_csv(gbk, encoding="gb18030").to_string(index=False))

# ---------- 2) UTF-8 BOM ----------
bom = d / "bom.csv"
bom.write_bytes(b"\xef\xbb\xbfid,name\n1,alice\n2,bob\n")
print()
print("=== 2. Excel 存出的 UTF-8 CSV 带 BOM ===")
raw = pd.read_csv(bom)
print("  直接读的列名 =", [repr(c) for c in raw.columns], " <- 第一个列名多了 \\ufeff")
try:
    raw["id"]
except KeyError as e:
    print("  raw['id'] -> KeyError:", str(e)[:40])
print("  用 encoding='utf-8-sig' 后列名 =", list(pd.read_csv(bom, encoding="utf-8-sig").columns))

# ---------- 3) 分隔符不对 ----------
semi = d / "semi.csv"
semi.write_text("a;b;c\n1;2;3\n", encoding="utf-8")
print()
print("=== 3. 分隔符不是逗号 ===")
wrong = pd.read_csv(semi)
print("  默认逗号读 -> shape =", wrong.shape, " 列名 =", list(wrong.columns), " <- 全挤成一列")
right = pd.read_csv(semi, sep=";")
print("  sep=';' 读  -> shape =", right.shape, " 列名 =", list(right.columns))

# ---------- 4) 脏值导致的类型退化 ----------
dirty = d / "dirty.csv"
dirty.write_text("id,amount\n001,10\n002,-\n003,3.5\n", encoding="utf-8")
print()
print("=== 4. 脏值让数值列退化为 object ===")
a = pd.read_csv(dirty)
print("  默认读：id dtype =", a["id"].dtype, " amount dtype =", a["amount"].dtype, " <- amount 变成 object")
b = pd.read_csv(dirty, dtype={"id": str}, na_values=["-"])
print("  显式指定：id dtype =", b["id"].dtype, " amount dtype =", b["amount"].dtype)
print("  修正后 id 保留了前导零:", b["id"].tolist())
print("  修正后 amount 的缺失:", b["amount"].isna().tolist())

# ---------- 5) 写出时的编码 ----------
out = d / "out.csv"
b.to_csv(out, index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig", na_rep="")
head = out.read_bytes()[:3]
print()
print("=== 5. 写出的文件头 ===")
print("  前 3 字节 =", head.hex(), "（efbbbf 即 BOM，Excel 才能正确识别中文）")
print("  index=False 时首行 =", out.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig").splitlines()[0])
